name: Joist
summary: Estimates, invoices and payments for solo contractors, with four plans.
differentiator: Priced for the solo electrician: about $14 a month on annual billing for unlimited documents, with estimates that convert to invoices. Scheduling arrives only on the highest plan.
pricing: Basics $8.34 a month on annual billing (up to 5 documents a month), Pro $14.17, Elite $26.67, Run $58.33 (an introductory price). Monthly billing costs more. 14-day free trial.

scope.takeoff: None described on the pages we read.
scope.library: Line items and photos on estimates. No electrical database is described.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Line items you enter. No price feed is named.

bestFor: One-person shops that need clean estimates, invoices and card payments.
skipIf: You need takeoff, assemblies or a price database.
watchOut: The Basics plan caps you at 5 documents a month.
